name: What should I prepare before contacting a contractor for a garage conversion?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting a contractor for a garage conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before requesting estimates, check local zoning regulations and any HOA covenants in your neighborhood, as some communities require minimum off-street covered parking. Decide whether the layout needs plumbing for a sink or bathroom, and determine where displaced tools, lawn care equipment, or vehicles will go. Having rough room dimensions and a clear idea of your target layout—such as where you want windows, closets, or entertainment walls—helps contractors provide accurate scopes for framing, insulation, drywall, and finish carpentry.
acceptedAnswer.description: Verify HOA parking rules, decide if you need plumbing for a bathroom, plan alternative storage for displaced items, and establish your desired room layout.
